brief_title: A Single Center Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ETC 1002 in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Placebo-Controlled, Randomized, Double-Blind, Parallel Group, Single Center Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ETC 1002 in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: assess the LDL-C lowering efficacy of ETC-1002 versus placebo in subjects with type 2 diabetes

brief_summary: This Phase 2 study will asses the LDL-C lowering efficacy of ETC-1002 versus placebo in subjects with type 2 diabetes.

inclusion.text: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes meeting all of the following:
Minimum 6 month history of diabetes prior to screening visit;
Fasting C-peptide ≥ 0.8 ng/mL at screening visit;
Fasting glucose from 140-270 mg/dL on Day -7 following washout of all glucose regulating drugs and supplements.
BMI at screening visit from 25-35 kg/m2;
